title: Pure Cicada
summary: Pure Cicada Rank 3 Insect swarm and control strategy centered on Dream Cicada, Transcicada, and Number 3: Cicada King, bolstered by Digital Bug and Gokipole extenders. By manipulating battle positions and swarming Level 3 Insects, the deck continuously triggers Number 3: Cicada King's monster negations and ranks up into high-impact Digital Bug Xyz bosses.

summary.title: Starters
points: Transcicada on Normal Summon Special Summons a Cicada Token, providing two Level 3 bodies instantly for a Rank 3 Xyz Summon or Link-2.
Dream Cicada Special Summons itself from hand whenever you control an Attack Position Insect, switching an opponent's monster (or your own) to Defense Position.
Digital Bug Websolder changes a face-up monster to Defense Position to Special Summon a Level 3 Insect from hand, while Digital Bug Cocoondenser revives a Level 3 Insect from the GY.
Gokipole searches an Insect when detached from an Xyz Monster or sent to the GY, fueling unending follow-up.

summary.title: Opening: Transcicada + Dream Cicada
steps: Normal Summon Transcicada and activate its effect to Special Summon a Level 3 Cicada Token.
Special Summon Dream Cicada from your hand since you control an Attack Position Insect, switching the Cicada Token to Defense Position.
Overlay Transcicada and Dream Cicada to Xyz Summon Number 3: Cicada King.
Link the Cicada Token and an extra body into Inzektor Picofalena, activating Picofalena's effect to equip Gokipole from Deck to Cicada King.
When Cicada King detaches Gokipole on the opponent's turn to negate a monster effect, trigger Gokipole in the GY to search another Insect.

summary.title: Bosses & Control
points: Number 3: Cicada King detaches an Xyz Material as a Quick Effect to negate a monster's activated effects, gains 500 DEF, and revives an Insect from hand or GY whenever its battle position changes.
Digital Bug Scaradiator detaches 2 materials to negate an opponent's face-up monster and change its battle position to Defense Position.
Digital Bug Corebage can Xyz Summon over a Rank 3 or 4 Insect Xyz (like Cicada King or Scaradiator) and detaches a material to shuffle an opponent's Defense Position monster into the Deck.
Digital Bug Rhinosebus ranks up over Corebage and detaches a material as a Quick Effect to destroy the opponent's highest-DEF monster(s).
Giant Beetrooper Invincible Atlas is an immune Link-4 juggernaut that tributes an Insect to summon another from the Deck.

summary.title: Spells & Traps
points: Bug Signal is a Quick-Play Spell that targets an Insect Xyz Monster you control to Special Summon an Insect Xyz Monster from your Extra Deck that is 2 Ranks higher.
Bug Emergency revives two Level 3 Insect monsters from your GY in Defense Position with their effects negated, instantly rebuilding a Rank 3 Cicada King.
Worm Bait summons two Insect Tokens to provide free Link material for Inzektor Picofalena or tributes for Invincible Atlas.
